summary: Blue Gold Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a Cayman Islands court judgment on preliminary issues in shareholder litigation related to its 2025 business combination with Perception Capital Corp. IV. The court ruled on share classification and consent requirements, continuing an injunction against an EGM to amend the Articles. No transaction terms, price, premium, or deal mechanics are stated; the filing only updates litigation status. This is a routine legal update with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic change. The matter remains pending trial. What to watch: resolution of outstanding claims and potential impact on corporate governance.
